name: Hey Girl Wonderful Smoke Tube Liquid Lipstick 4pcs Box
description:
Item type: lipstick set 
Quantity: 2.5g x 4pcs 
Application: lip makeup, embellishment and contouring 
HIGH QUALITY LIPSTICKS - This is a four color flue tube lipstick set. Cigarette shape appearance, precise lip lines, easy to use. 4 lipstick pens can meet your different needs. 
Matte texture: comfortable texture, bright color, matte liquid lipstick, beautiful appearance. Thanks to the fully matte effect, the make-up is more advanced and stronger in coverage, which can cover dull lips. 
Smooth application: smooth lipstick can be easily applied to your lips, the texture is soft and does not get caught when using. Plant extract ingredients, safe and no stimulation, no harm to your lips. 
DURABLE, EASY TO COLOR: Long lasting makeup effect to create a three-dimensional feel for the face. Full colour and shine, easy to dye, soft texture, add your charm.
